White Knight Corps GOC visits Udhampur encounter site

The General Officer Commanding (GOC) of the White Knight Corps visited the site of a recent encounter in Udhampur, Jammu and Kashmir, on the day after the incident. The visit was reported by The Tribune and Greater Kashmir. During the visit, the commander reviewed ongoing counter‑terrorism operations in the district. No additional details about casualties, suspects, or outcomes were provided in the reports. The coverage did not include statements from officials beyond the commander’s presence.
